decisions.statement: The folder above is named the plural one or more page types gather their pages under.
A folder whose folder above is named no page type's plural is refused.
A page type that plural covers is one of those page types or a page type extending one.
The folder is named for exactly one page type that plural covers.
A folder named for no such page type is refused.
A folder named for more than one such page type is refused.
Every page here is of that page type or of a page type extending it.
A page sits here as a file of its own or in a folder of its own.
A file that is neither a page nor a file beside one is refused.
A folder holding no page at all is refused.
The files a page in a folder of its own holds are judged where that page is.

definition: the shape of a folder named for one page type, under that type's plural, with its pages
